scope: Serialized host-domain exclusion, immutable authority epochs, hidden stages and whole-bundle activation mechanism; concrete service enrollment and combined session persistence remain D4e-2

verified_behavior: One serialized domain exclusion covers enrolled runtime access, complete capture callback, hidden construction, authority replacement and whole-bundle activation. Reentry refuses Busy.
Private domain/authority/configuration identities, checked epochs and bundle generations bind stages and credentials; success consumes stages and invalidates old generation credentials.

Immutable approved configurations enroll exact factories, permissions and bindings. Requirement failures are sticky. Revocation, narrowing and resolver/configuration changes invalidate staged work; safe restaging preserves current authority.
Activation checks precomputed proofs and exchanges one bundle under the same guard with no production callback or factory between final check and exchange; result storage is reserved first.
Hidden construction and encoder refusal/panic preserve the nonempty destination and release the guard. Epoch/generation exhaustion refuses without wrapping.

Committed retirement and mutable runtime panic fail-stop instead of claiming rollback. Detached owned factory references contain destructor panic payloads; duplicate-validation cleanup protects displaced, enrolled and unprocessed references individually.
Caller-retained naked Rc references remain outside configuration-owned destructor containment. Shared reference lifetime and immutable factory invocation are preserved.
D1 transport format and API remain unchanged. Entity-free heterogeneous bundle fixtures exercise the mechanism; concrete service adapters are not yet enrolled.
findings_resolved: R1: detached ApprovedConfiguration could allow its owned factory destructor to unwind despite documented containment. Each owned reference is now protected before validation; supplied repro and six durable regressions pass.

failure_history.note: Original Cargo argument failure, reviewer fixture compilation and R1 failing repro retained; one successful repair/zero unsuccessful repairs. Repair packaging and readback scratch-path failures retained without resets.

trust_premises: Native purity, fidelity, bounded work, immutable factory/resolver configuration, complete semantic/reference/permission proof enrollment, private allocation, alias exclusion and effect-free construction/drop remain host premises.
Host runtime adapter callbacks are not a guest capability sandbox. Retained service aliases must be concretely enrolled in D4e-2; wrapping a slot does not gate unenrolled aliases.
Threaded execution is Unsupported; there is no threaded exclusion proof. Wasm checks compilation, not native unwinding.
Nested destructor panic during unwind, allocator abort and panic=abort remain process fail-stop. No crash rollback, external IO exactly-once or composed Lean-to-Rust refinement claim.
